_comment: Eight project roles for DGTLPROD. Roles are global Jira artifacts (POST /rest/api/3/role) but actor assignments are per-project (POST /rest/api/3/project/DGTLPROD/role/{id}). Create roles globally first, then assign actors below.

roles.name: dp_requester
roles.description: Anyone in Avangrid · can submit demands at intake form (status NEW)

roles.name: dp_pm_per_vs
roles.description: PMs assigned per Value Stream · review, score (BV/UX), and triage demands

roles.name: dp_architect
roles.description: Cross-VS architects · score Safety + Effort at ANALYZING · feasibility judgement

roles.name: dp_director_cs
roles.description: CS Directors · approve at Gate 2 (Portfolio Committee)

roles.name: dp_director_itba
roles.description: ITBA Director · approves at Gate 2 (Portfolio Committee)

roles.name: dp_squad_lead
roles.description: Squad lead per Value Stream · pulls from Backlog · drives delivery

roles.name: dp_admin
roles.description: NTT DATA delivery + Avangrid product owner (post-handover) · full project admin

_note_emails: Email addresses listed above are best-known at design time. If any user has migrated/left, replace before assignment.
